addition.item: Let the amount of the Stripe element come from a form field, and refuse the form when the field holds no valid amount.
Show the email body and template settings in the Administrator Notification tab.
Group the Stripe element settings in sections, with masked keys, the test or production mode, and automatic or manual payment methods.

change.item: Use the browser tooltips of the title attributes in the administration, as the Joomla article list does.
Use EUR by default for the Stripe element, and rename iDEAL | Wero to Wero.

fix.item: Keep a setting that a form options screen does not send, instead of resetting it on save.
Complete QuickMode saves on forms with old elements when the site displays PHP notices: options, version and reload were lost.
Reload the page after each QuickMode save, so the title shows the new version number.
Keep the rich text editors working while the QuickMode Options tab is saved.
Show a clear save message with its icon.
Load the QuickMode tree script with its version, so a browser cannot keep an old copy after an update.

addition.item: Show the email body of the user confirmation: a preview of the default email, or the template editor with its field variables.
List what is attached to a package before dissolving it, and warn that a later import creates duplicates.
Add one icon and one color per field type, grouped by family, in the QuickMode menu and tree.

change.item: Let the Stripe Dashboard set the payment methods: card must be enabled there, and other enabled methods can appear on the payment page.
Rename Create Package to Create or edit package, its download button to Export package, and move Delete package to the Configuration screen as Dissolve package.
Choose the package of a form from a list of existing packages.
Hide the Viewed and Exported columns of the records list by default.
Show the QuickMode Options tab on the form root only, and add a tooltip to every label of the form options.
Use paquet instead of package in the French interface.

fix.item: Open the Stripe payment page again: Stripe now refuses payment_method_types.
Restore the settings of the User Confirmation tab, which each save reset, custom template included.
Repair the Edit modals of the QuickMode page and section texts.
Keep the code edited in scripts and pieces when saving on the classic form screen.
Share the width between the QuickMode tree and panel on narrow screens.
Repair the Keep panel docked and Scroll element list settings of QuickMode.
Show the arrow of the back to top button.

addition.item: Offer Klarna and iDEAL | Wero on the Stripe Checkout page, as options of the Stripe element.
Record Stripe payments from a signed webhook, even when the customer does not come back to the site.
Write the component warnings and errors to administrator/logs/com_breezingformsng.php.

remove.item: Remove the Sofort element, discontinued by Klarna: stored Sofort elements are no longer shown, and QuickMode drops them when the form is opened.

fix.item: Show a payment error instead of a fatal error when Stripe cannot open the payment page.
Check that a Stripe session belongs to the record it confirms, and record a payment only once.
Refuse submissions of a form whose only payment was Sofort until another payment is set up, instead of accepting them unpaid.
Unpublish a form whose only payment was Sofort when QuickMode saves it without Stripe or PayPal, instead of making it free.
Restore the code framework buttons of the QuickMode custom scripts and keep the alert setting on the next-page check.
Remove the output buffer notice after a form submission.
Display a form page without an active menu item, and keep stored QuickMode forms intact when the update cannot rewrite their old links.
Repair migration of legacy BreezingForms installations, including menu links, component registration, and stored record dates.
Keep QuickMode checkbox changes when saving properties and close its editor dialog after saving.
Correct QuickMode form submission and summary display issues.

addition.item: Keep and restore version history for forms, scripts, and pieces.
Show record audit information and allow active, archived, viewed, and exported states to be changed directly.
Integrate with Joomla privacy requests to export or remove personal data from form records.

change.item: Use Joomla administration lists, search tools, and pagination for forms, menus, records, scripts, pieces, and integrator rules.
Use ContentBuilder NG services for linked forms and records.
Provide a dedicated Joomla form for CSV record imports.
Upgrade the QuickMode editor tree to jsTree 3 while keeping existing form data.

fix.item: Add the columns BreezingForms NG needs when it is installed over existing BreezingForms Pro tables. Records, Forms, Scripts and Pieces no longer fail with "Unknown column" errors.
Remove the "Database update version does not match" warning shown for BreezingForms NG in Joomla's database maintenance screen.
Keep each plugin's enabled or disabled state on install and update instead of enabling all plugins again.
Stop re-applying unchanged column definitions on every update.
Display script descriptions containing HTML characters correctly in the script editor.
Fix untranslated text in the audit report and after copying scripts or pieces with nothing selected.

addition.item: The audit now reports table columns that are missing and forms left with debug mode enabled.
Pieces and scripts can be published or unpublished from their editor with a single click, saved immediately.

change.item: In the piece and script editors, help text now appears when hovering a field label, and the piece description is a resizable text area.
The About screen shows version information first, with a shorter introduction and collapsed library lists.
The audit toolbar button is now labelled "Audit".
